title: Review, restore or fork without overwriting edits
steps: Open the exact native candidate diff; review mapped criteria.
Choose a recorded checkpoint from the timeline.
Inspect content coverage and file preconditions.
Choose a supported restore or fork scope.
Preview unrelated edits and uncovered effects.
Perform a separate transaction if valid; recheck CAS preconditions inside the restore transaction.
forbidden_fake_states: old proof reused for a new tree
complete_when: a changed candidate invalidates stale proof; historical verified artifacts remain historical (p.186).
traceability: p.186; controls V-01..V-06, V-12, D-06, Q-09; acceptance A33, A34.
